chapter: Oliver, Kelly and the district bands
title: Personnel of Joe Oliver's Magnolia band
summary: Dawson names Chris Minor, Pop Foster, Willie Foster, Eddie Atkins, Oliver and a clarinetist (Lorenzo Tio) in the Magnolia band; he played briefly.
